text.en: Valluvar says a guest is a treasure.

Thirukkural is a book of 1330 two-line couplets in 133 chapters, by Thiruvalluvar. This unit's kurals are on hospitality and related virtues.
The kurals teach that welcoming guests is a duty of a householder and a sign of a cultured life.
Learn each kural with its word-by-word meaning. Revise the chapter name (அதிகாரம்) and the part (பால்).
